ingestionTime.description: Date and time when the databudget document was consolidated and ingested

reportName.description: Name of the source databudget report file this record was derived from

databudget_type.description: Original product type as declared in the databudget report

database_type.description: Product type as used in the database, expanded from the compacted databudget type notation

database_timeliness.description: Timeliness label as used in the database, mapped from the databudget timeliness through the lookup table

num_day.description: Expected number of products per day declared in the databudget

data_category.description: Category of the record: RAW, GLOBAL_THRESHOLD, SPECIFIC_THRESHOLD or TIMELINESS_LUT

level.description: Product processing level (e.g. L0, L1, L2)

timeliness.description: Timeliness of the product as declared in the databudget

produced.description: Production service value for the product type as declared in the databudget

archived.description: Archiving service value for the product type as declared in the databudget

disseminated.description: Dissemination service value for the product type as declared in the databudget

volume_day.description: Expected data volume produced per day for the product type

mission.description: Mission the databudget entry applies to (e.g. S1, S2)

version.description: Version of the databudget the record was generated from

threshold_subtype.description: Service type (e.g. PRIP, LTA, DA) the threshold applies to

threshold_volume.description: Expected daily data volume threshold, summed from the databudget volume per day

threshold_count.description: Expected daily product count threshold, summed from the databudget count per day
